sandbox_image.distribution: Built locally with scripts/build-sandbox.sh; not published to a registry.

scenarios_passed: Network unavailable, input read-only, explicitly mounted output writable, 256 MiB and 1 CPU cgroup limits verified

semgrep.provenance: The 0.2.3 image build runs an offline Semgrep scan with a read-only source mount and checks its report on the host. That check passed when this image was built on 2026-11-22; it was not repeated for this record. The image is the same one used for 0.9.8.

limitations: Host is macOS arm64; this is not a Windows Docker or Linux KVM qualification.
Docker failure recovery scenarios cover only disposable owned containers.
All seven tests reported ok (six scenarios and the recovery helper).
The sandbox image is unchanged from 0.9.8 (0.2.3). Only the linux/arm64 build was used here; the linux/amd64 build was not.
